integrity: The proof uses a prime-local p-adic cancellation lemma, a two-sided head/tail inequality and exact upward-rounded integer residue dynamic programming. No numerical solver or floating-point decisions are needed.
scientific_limitations: This establishes 41 <= r <= 47, not the exact minimum r; unrestricted tail is handled analytically. Watanabe conjectures 47.
title: A forty-term obstruction for distinct semiprime Egyptian fractions
